purpose: Historical source observations for a demo; not live inventory or a current market benchmark.
comparison_scope: Seller-described Sony WH-1000XM5 over-ear headphones, black, new. Item price only; no added accessory bundles. Contents, authenticity, regional warranty and seller condition claims were not independently inspected.
limitations: Nine distinct eBay item URLs were opened: eight fixed-price observations (six US, two JP) plus one US candidate with unknown purchase type. Cached pages range from 2 days to 3 months old, not simultaneous observations.
Exact capture timestamps are unknown. Retrieval date is when cached evidence was read, not when a listing or price was current.
Prices from opened pages take precedence over differing search snippets; no prices were invented or adjusted to force a bargain.
Current availability is unknown. Old seller-away messages and checkout connection errors occur in returned pages.
Shipping is null because destination-specific cached shipping quotes cannot establish delivery cost for the demo user. Taxes and duties are excluded.

Use for historical item-price comparison only. No guarantee of current availability, authenticity, purchase eligibility or final delivered cost. These selected observations do not establish a market price.

US and JP item-location groups are separate. Location is not regional SKU, manufacturing origin or delivery eligibility. Country filtering can use both groups; strict regional/warranty equivalence and international landed costs remain unverified.
